title: fMRI study of brilliant moves in the game of Go

tellings.quote: you know a study where you hook up uh somebody's brain to an fmri and they're playing the game of Go

plain: There is said to be a study in which a person's brain was watched in a brain scanner while they played Go, the ancient board game, to see what happens in the mind during a brilliant move. Michels brings it up himself, without naming the study or saying what it found. He mentions it in a talk about the mind and where flashes of insight come from.
